login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Email or password is incorrect. After repeated failures, sign-in is blocked for a few minutes.
login.passwordSet: Password saved. Sign in with the new password.
login.passwordReset: Password changed and all previous sessions ended. Sign in with the new password.
login.passkeyUnknown: This passkey does not belong to any account in DMN Zeit.

invite.title: Set password
invite.invalid: Invitation links are valid for 7 days and work once. The company's administration can send a new one.

verify.title: Confirm sign-in
verify.expired: The second step has expired. It has to be completed within 5 minutes of the password.

totp.intro: Enter the six-digit code from the authenticator app.
totp.label: Code from the app
totp.wrong: The code is incorrect. Codes change every 30 seconds.

recovery.intro: Enter one of the recovery codes. Each code works only once.
recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.wrong: This code is not valid or has already been used.

passkey.intro: Confirm with a passkey of this account.
passkey.wrong: This passkey does not belong to this account.

reset.requestIntro: The reset link goes to the email address on file and is valid for 30 minutes.
reset.requestSent: If the address is on file, an email with the link is on its way.
reset.title: New password
reset.invalid: Reset links are valid for 30 minutes and work once.
